name: choiceforge-architecture-benchmark-v1
purpose: Independent audit of the frozen decoder-versus-encoder architecture study

sealed_arc.release_policy: The raw and transformed ARC rows remain sealed and are generated locally from the pinned public source only.

conversion_policy: Legacy frozen probability predictions are converted with probability argmax as choice_id and requires_review=true; no weights or predictions are retrained.
leakage_boundary: The sealed ARC task set is never used for training, temperature fitting, endpoint selection or protocol changes.
public_data_boundary: Only public-source manifests and frozen public-study artifacts are allowed; no personal, company or private data is part of the benchmark.
